description: Pillr gives free, no-login access to French real estate public data: the price per square meter for any municipality, a market summary (rent, yield, price trends, zoning), and the permit or declaration requirements for a renovation project. Every figure is sourced from official public data (DVF, DHUP, INSEE) and French urbanism law, with no listings, no addresses, and no proprietary scoring shown.

defaultPrompt: What is the average price per square meter for apartments in Lyon
Give me a market summary for Annecy: rent, yield and price trend
Do I need a building permit to add a 20m2 extension in Bordeaux
